question: Produce a hunt-ready dossier on malware "ExampleRAT": capabilities, IOCs, ATT&CK, detection, and gaps.

reports.answer: ExampleRAT is a remote access trojan using DLL side-loading (T1574.002) and web-protocol C2 (T1071.001). Block hashes: abc123 (block). Detection: alert on rundll32 spawning from temp paths. Gaps: no config extraction available. [1][2]
